title: Demon Path Commander · Ancient Conspiracy
next_chapter_hook: Just as the two were about to shake hands and form an alliance, a complex light flickered in Ye Qing's eyes, and she softly spoke a forbidden name—that was an existence that had been sleeping for a thousand years in the depths of the Holy Sect.

text.content:
Moonlight like frost fell upon the cliff of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.

Chen Ji turned slowly, the moonlight outlining his calm face, as if he had long anticipated this moment. His spiritual sense quietly extended, confirming no third person within a hundred zhang.

"Ye Qing Saint's Demonic Path Mist is indeed well-deserved." His voice carried no trace of fluctuation, "Even my perception can be shielded. However—"

He paused, the corners of his lips slightly rising: "If you truly wanted to kill me, you shouldn't have spoken just now."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing stood three zhang away, her dark silk dress gently swaying in the night wind, her eyes like cold stars in an abyss, deep and dangerous.

"Chen Ji, you are more composed than I imagined." She stepped forward slowly, demonic energy swirling around her yet somehow not dissipating outward, "A worthless servant of Tianqing Sect, cultivating from a meridian-blocked废物 to Qi Refining ninth layer in three years—do you think the Holy Sect's intelligence network is for show?"

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't retreat; instead, he slightly tilted his head to meet Ye Qing's gaze. This movement caused a flicker of surprise in Ye Qing's eyes—ordinary cultivators in the presence of a Demonic Path Saint would find it difficult to even remain standing.

"Saint, visiting at midnight, surely not just to compliment me?" he said softly, his tone carrying a hint of mockery, "Go ahead, what do you need?"

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing stopped walking, her gaze meeting Chen Ji's for a moment before she suddenly let out a soft laugh. That laugh was cold as ice, yet carried a dangerous allure in the night.

"Interesting." She raised her hand, her fingertips condensing a jet-black token with a closed vertical eye engraved upon it, "Do you know what this is?"

text.content:
The moment Chen Ji's gaze fell upon that token, the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea violently trembled, emitting an urgent warning.

That feeling he knew too well—every time he foresaw events related to major karma, the Tianji Record would give a similar response. The last time he felt this was when he glimpsed the scene of his sister Chen Nian being taken away by the Holy Sect.

"Speak." His tone suddenly turned cold, "What does this have to do with the Tianji Record?"

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing retrieved the token, a sharp gleam flickering in her eyes: "You indeed know the Tianji Record. No—it should be said, you indeed possess the Tianji Record."

She stepped forward, lowering her voice: "The master of this token is a... being in the depths of the Holy Sect. We call him the 'Commander.' Legend has it he is related to a prophet from ancient times, and that prophet was the first holder of the Tianji Record."

text.content:
The night wind suddenly rose, Chen Ji's robes fluttering in the gust. He didn't speak, but in his heart was already a stormy sea.

The first holder of the Tianji Record—Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned this history. And if what Ye Qing said was true, then this mysterious Commander might be the original... master of the Tianji Record? Or the first prophet chosen by the Tianji Record?

Either possibility meant that this chessboard of chaos was far older than he had imagined.

choice.prompt: Facing this earth-shaking information, Chen Ji needed to decide how to respond—whether to directly interrogate for more intelligence, or first state his stance to probe Ye Qing's true intentions?

choices.text: Directly interrogate about the Commander's identity
choices.description: Since the Tianji Record reacted, it meant this information was crucial. Chen Ji decided to ask directly, without beating around the bush.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the importance placed on the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May let Ye Qing gauge your bottom line

dialogue.content: "Where is this Commander now?" Chen Ji's voice was calm, but his eyes were sharp as blades, "Since you know these things, you should also understand his connection to the Tianji Record."

Ye Qing seemed somewhat surprised by his directness, but quickly恢复了常态: "His location... even I am not certain. But I know his goal." Her voice dropped, "He wants to collect all fragments of the Tianji Record."

choices.description: Since Ye Qing proactively disclosed these, it meant she had demands. Chen Ji decided to first state his position, showing sincerity for cooperation.
choices.visible_reward: Make Ye Qing trust you more

dialogue.content: "You want to deal with him." Chen Ji didn't take the bait, but calmly stated his judgment, "Otherwise you wouldn't tell me these things."
Ye Qing's pupils slightly contracted, then burst into a dangerous yet appreciative smile: "Indeed as smart as Chen Xuan. Correct, the Commander is my enemy—and the enemy of the entire Demonic Path."

choices.description: Don't rush to take a stance, first see what price Ye Qing is willing to pay for this cooperation.
choices.visible_cost: May cause the dialogue to stall

dialogue.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile carrying a hint of calculation: "Saint came visiting at midnight, surely not just to tell me stories. Speak, what do you need from me?—and what can you give me?"
Ye Qing narrowed her eyes,打量着眼前这个年轻的杂役弟子，忽然觉得有些看不透他: "你不怕我是来杀你的？"

text.content:
The night wind suddenly stopped, surrounding falling into an eerie silence.

Chen Ji knew every word he spoke was being analyzed by Ye Qing, and he was also analyzing her. A Demonic Path Saint coming alone at night to reveal the Holy Sect's highest secrets—this itself was the greatest sincerity, and the greatest risk.

What was she after?

dialogue.content:
"You want to know why the Commander is my enemy?" Ye Qing suddenly spoke, her voice carrying a rare bitterness, "Because I am not a Saint—I am a sacrifice."

She raised her hand, her sleeve falling back to reveal a ferocious black pattern on her wrist, like parasitic vines wrapped beneath her skin: "This is the 'Heavenly Fate Lock' planted by the Holy Sect. Every year, it devours part of my lifespan and cultivation, feeding that sleeping existence."

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze subtly凝. Heavenly Fate Lock—this name he had seen in the fragments of the Tianji Record, recorded in a certain prophet's annotations.

"So you want to resist." he said slowly, "And the Commander... is the source of all this."

Ye Qing nodded, a flash of determination in her eyes: "I know you have the Tianji Record. It can foresee the future—I need your ability to find a way to kill him or remove the Heavenly Fate Lock. In exchange—"

dialogue.content: "My Demonic Path Mist can help you shield the aura of the Tianji Record." Ye Qing stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, "You should know that every use of the Tianji Record leaves traces. Holy Sect, Xuanwu Sect, even within Tianqing Sect—how many eyes are watching you, you know better than me."

text.content:
This sentence hit Chen Ji's heart.

Every foresight by the Tianji Record indeed left causal ripples in the void. Had it not been for Mo Xiansheng's residual soul helping to conceal, he would have been discovered by those with ulterior motives long ago. And Demonic Path Mist—that was a divine ability that could briefly shield even the will of Heavenly Dao. If it could be used...

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's conditions were tempting enough, but Chen Ji needed to consider: should he agree to cooperate now, or first probe for more trump cards?

choices.text: Agree to cooperate, but retain trump cards
choices.description: Cooperation was the general trend, but Chen Ji wouldn't easily give away all his chips. He agreed to cooperate, but only committed to limited help.

dialogue.content: "Cooperation is acceptable." Chen Ji spoke calmly, "But I need to see your sincerity—first help me shield the Tianji Record's aura once, letting me confirm your ability is real."
Ye Qing looked at him deeply,似乎在评估他的可信度.片刻后,她伸出手: "成交。但我也有一个条件——你欠我一个人情，将来我要你帮我完成一个任务。"

choices.description: Since it's cooperation, it should be equal. Chen Ji demanded Ye Qing first provide more intelligence about the Commander and Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "Before I agree," Chen Ji raised one finger, "I need to know more. The Commander's cultivation, location, weaknesses—and what does he have to do with the Eye of Heavenly Dao?"
Ye Qing's pupils subtly contracted,显然没想到他会知道"天道之眼"这个名字.沉默了片刻后,她缓缓开口: "你知道的比我想象的多...好，我告诉你。但不是现在，不是这里。"

text.content:
The moon passed the midpoint, the atmosphere on the cliff subtly changing.

From the initial confrontation, to now a certain tacit understanding—two people who should have been enemies were establishing a connection in a subtle way.

Chen Ji suddenly spoke: "Who is Chen Xuan?"

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's footsteps paused, she turned back to look at Chen Ji, her eyes flickering with complex emotions.

"You don't know Chen Xuan?" she seemed to be confirming something, then softly said, "He was the previous holder of the Tianji Record. Twenty years ago, he suddenly disappeared, everyone thought he was dead. But I saw in the Commander's memory fragments—he didn't die, he was... sacrificed."

text.content:
Sacrificed.

This word was like a cold blade, stabbing into Chen Ji's heart. He thought of Mo Xiansheng—that existence in residual soul form on the first page of the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned Chen Xuan's true fate.

And now he knew: Chen Xuan, that person who might once have possessed the complete Tianji Record, ultimately became a sacrifice for some ancient conspiracy.

"I understand." Chen Ji's voice was calm, but deep in his eyes, a cold light flashed, "So you want to break this cycle."

dialogue.content:
"Exactly." Ye Qing nodded, "Every generation of Tianji Record holders ultimately gets devoured by the Commander. This is the will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao—it needs to continuously devour prophets to maintain its existence. And you and I, we are both its chess pieces."

She stepped forward, the distance between her and Chen Ji now only one zhang: "I don't want to be a chess piece. What about you?"

text.content:
On the cliff, the two stared at each other.

One was a Demonic Path Saint, seemingly an invader, but actually another prisoner; the other was a废物 disciple, seemingly an ant, but actually a chess player holding Heavenly Secrets.

At this moment, some kind of strange resonance rose between them—both were chess pieces, both were struggling, both wanted to overturn the chessboard.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's words pointed directly at the core—the Eye of Heavenly Dao, ancient conspiracy, generational sacrifice. Chen Ji needed to make a final decision.

choices.text: Form alliance to resist Heavenly Dao
choices.description: Since the Eye of Heavenly Dao was a common enemy, there was no reason not to join forces. Chen Ji decided to officially ally with Ye Qing.
choices.visible_cost: Get drawn into a bigger whirlpool
choices.risk_hint: May become a target of the Eye of Heavenly Dao

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji extended his hand: "I won't be a chess piece. I want to overturn this game."

Ye Qing looked at his hand, then after a moment, also extended her hand, their palms touching. a cold force transmitted from her palm, that was the aura of Demonic Path Mist, beginning to resonate with his Tianji Record in some way.

"From now on," Ye Qing's voice was low and solemn, "I shield you from wind and rain in the shadows, you plan the world for me in the light. Demonic Path and Tianqing Sect, from this moment, become allies in attack and defense."

choices.description: 信息量太大，陈机需要时间消化。他决定暂时不做承诺，先回去与墨先生商议。

dialogue.content:
"让我考虑考虑。"陈机后退一步，"三天之内，我会给你答复。"

夜清眉头微皱，但没有强求："可以。但你要快——主帅的觉醒，不会等任何人。"

夜风再次吹起，带来远处战火的硝烟气息。

夜清转身准备离去，忽然又停下脚步，背对着陈机说道："对了，还有一件事。"她的声音忽然变得有些古怪，"你那个妹妹——陈念，她还活着。就在圣宗深处，主帅的寝宫旁边。"

陈机的瞳孔骤然收缩。

text.content:
这一刻，陈机心中某根紧绷的弦猛然断裂。

陈念——他失踪三年的妹妹，被圣宗带走的那个女孩。他一直在暗中寻找，却从未得到确切的消息。而现在，夜清轻描淡写地说出了她的下落。

"为什么告诉我这个？"他的声音有些沙哑。

夜清回头，月光照亮她半边脸庞，那双深邃的眼眸中，似乎藏着某种陈机读不懂的情绪："因为这是我欠你的。将来你帮我完成任务时，你会知道为什么。"

她踏空而起，魔气在她脚下凝聚成云："三天后，我会来找你。陈机——别让我失望。"

魔云远去，夜色重归寂静。

陈机独自站在断崖之上，良久未动。

神
